newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share market steady at early pre-Xmas close.
newsitem.headline: NZ share market steady at early pre-Xmas close.

text.p: * NZ top 40 index ends 0.89 points higher
* Volumes low but reasonable given looming Christmas holiday
New Zealand shares ended their Christmas Eve session flat on Tuesday, as trading closed early at noon ahead of Wednesday's holiday.

The NZSE40 Capital Index finished a grand total of 0.89 points higher at 2,344.70. The small companies index was down 8.64 points. Telecom was the biggest mover among the main stocks, down four cents at NZ$7.08.
Brokers said most people had gone on holiday already and closed up shop, and there was little to report.
"Volumes are pretty low across most stocks and there haven't really been any particularly big highlights at all," one dealer said.
"I wouldn't say a non-event, but it's relatively quiet going into Christmas, and people are stuffing the stockings."
Volume was a light NZ$19.9 million.
